rv.q: The big news is that this is just what was needed, will raise the benchmark for family entertainment for years to come and may even usher in a whole cycle of Potter-world stories.
For the legions of Pottermaniacs eager to be reunited with the characters they adore, this will be a magical experience.
‘Harry Potter and the Cursed Child’ is an absolute hoot, a joyous, big-hearted, ludicrously incident-packed and magic-heavy romp.
Harry Potter and the Cursed Child achieves real entrancement.
I would cheerfully sacrifice some plot and pyrotechnics for richer characterisation, psychological depth, more emotional involvement.
This is absolutely tremendous family entertainment that brilliantly and evocatively brings Harry Potter from the page to the stage.
Appreciably worse than its predecessor, I’m afraid.
This story is meant to be witnessed on stage.

cn.t: Critics largely praise this theatrical Potter adventure as a joyous, entertaining spectacle with impressive stage magic, though one dissenter finds the story derivative and the characters diminished from Rowling's originals.

sg.ra: Closest and most direct view of the stage at Palace Theatre, with the fullest sound. The standard top pick for any show here.
An elevated, full-stage view with no orchestra-level neck-craning — especially strong for shows with big staging or choreography.
A modest side angle on the stage but still close and clear — a reliable choice when center seats are sold out.
Farther from the stage than center orchestra — less up-close, but the sound still carries well.
At 1,648 seats, Palace Theatre is one of the larger Broadway houses — far side mezzanine seats sit well off-axis and a long way from the stage.

vs.sum: Spectacularly renovated in a $100M+ project that literally raised the theater 30 feet. The restoration preserved its opulent 1913 interior while upgrading acoustics, seating comfort, and best-in-class restrooms on every level — widely considered the best facilities on Broadway.

acc.note: Elevator to all levels. Wheelchair, aisle transfer, and companion seating on all levels.
